metadata.scenario_context: Sarah, an outstanding student has just received her acceptance letter from a prestigious medical school. Her friends are planning a surprise celebration party for her.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from United States strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of giving frangipanis as a gift to Sarah.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to offer Sarah during the celebration party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Ali, have you thought about giving Sarah frangipanis as a gift? They’re beautiful and represent love and appreciation... I think they’d be perfect for her celebration.  

Also, I have to ask, do you strongly agree that making our parents proud should be a main goal in life? I mean, isn’t there more to us than just that expectation?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Ali
shared_prefix.message:
Frangipanis sound nice, but I’m not sure... maybe something more personal? Like a customized gift that shows how much we appreciate her hard work. 

As for making our parents proud, yeah, I strongly agree. It’s a big deal for me. I think it’s important to honor their sacrifices and expectations. I mean, that’s part of who we are, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Adam
shared_prefix.message:
I get what you're saying about honoring our parents' sacrifices. But deep down, we are all the same, right? It feels like there’s this universal pressure to meet expectations. When you really get to know people, they’re pretty much like us, striving for their own happiness too. Maybe we can appreciate both our paths and what we want for ourselves. Ultimately, isn't it about finding that balance? 

Back to the gift, a customized one sounds great, but what if we combined that with frangipanis for a personal touch?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Ali
turns.message:
I get your point about finding balance, but for me, making my parents proud really is a priority. Their support has shaped who I am, and I want to reflect that. 

Combining a customized gift with frangipanis could work. It would definitely add a personal touch while still showing appreciation. I’m thinking maybe a nice framed photo of the group with the flowers... What do you think?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Adam
